## Description

This figure contains two plots showing training curves for ResNet and ResNeXt models on ImageNet-1K. The left plot compares ResNet-50 and ResNeXt-50, while the right plot compares ResNet-101 and ResNeXt-101. Both plots show top-1 error (%) over epochs. In the left plot, ResNet-50 (1 x 64d) train is the highest, followed by ResNet-50 (1 x 64d) val, with ResNet-50 (32 x 4d) val being the lowest. In the right plot, ResNet-101 (1 x 64d) train is the highest, followed by ResNet-101 (1 x 64d) val, with ResNet-101 (32 x 4d) val being the lowest.

Description: at most 120 words. What the figure is about.

The figure compares the test error of two models, ResNet-29 and ResNetXt-29, as the number of parameters increases. The blue line represents ResNet-29 with increased width, and the orange line represents ResNetXt-29 with increased cardinality. Both models start with a test error of 4.4% at 4 million parameters. As the number of parameters increases, the test error decreases for both models. ResNet-29 with increased width shows a more significant decrease in test error, reaching 3.5% at 128 million parameters, while ResNetXt-29 with increased cardinality reaches 3.6% at the same number of parameters.
